name: coherence-companion
description: Practical companion workflows for learning, ideas, design, creation, research and collaboration, with choices and sharing in your hands.

interface.longDescription: Work through learning, ideas, design, writing, research and collaboration with practical workflows that adapt to your pace. Turn rough material into useful drafts, keep assumptions and decisions clear, and create an editable session brief to continue elsewhere. Choose what to save or share. Open-source guidance uses your host's available tools and data controls; optional Coherence Network tools are configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this rough idea into a useful first draft.
Teach me this at my level and let me try.
Help us clarify decisions and agree on the next step.
